# Isometric anatomy — Style Prompt

> A calm technical figure: one real, well-made physical machine drawn in precise isometric on near-white paper, built from many small solid parts (a base on feet, rails and rulers with ticks, knurled knobs, coil springs, a dial gauge, screws as dots), shaded in four quiet tones with thin ink outlines, framed in a card with "Fig 1" top left, a mono caps title top right, a hint pill bottom left and a live readout bottom right. The machine's working is the explanation: the needle, the readout and the caption all come from the same model that moves the parts.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

**The object is the explanation.** Invent a recognisable machine whose mechanism maps one-to-one onto the idea, and let it work in front of the viewer: a parcel scale whose springs sink and whose needle reads the weight, a grinder whose dial sets the grind, a stamping press that counts orders, a till drawer that opens per sale, a water meter for a class on usage. Say in one sentence what moves and what that motion means, then build that.

It is not an infographic of labelled boxes and arrows, not floating slabs or stacked plates, not one big block with a few lines on it (too abstract, too flat), not a cartoon and not a 3D render. No leader lines, balloons, dimension arrows or labels in the drawing: words live in the card corners and the caption under the card; at most one tiny engraved word on a part (a "kg" on the dial).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Camera**: true isometric-style projection, azimuth 42–45°, elevation 30°; x and y on the floor, z up (z projects straight up on screen, so vertical travel is a plain screen translate). World units of about one millimetre of the real thing; fit the assembled machine to 55–65 % of the card.
- **Solids, not wireframes**: every part is an extrusion of a rounded plan (or a circle) filled in paper colour, painted back to front, so near parts hide far ones. No see-through edges, no dashed hidden lines.
- **Four-tone shading**: each visible side face takes one of four tones by how it faces a fixed light; the top is paper. Outline = the silhouette (hi or mid), crease = the front top edge (faint), plus a bevel line where useful.
- **Tone hierarchy**: base and feet lo/mid, structure mid, the subject (the parcel, the product) hi, and exactly one lit part in the main colour (the needle). Grooves faint, minor ticks lo, major ticks mid.
- **Small precise detail, never noise**: grooves inset 4–5 units from a plate edge, screws as dots with a ring at plate corners, knurls on every knob, ruler strips with ticks every 4 units and a major every 5th, a label plate with three rule lines, thumb screws on clamps, a soft halo (radial gradient) under the base and under anything lifted. Every detail belongs to a part and every line ends on something.
- **Painter's order**: draw static base parts once in one group, then the moving assemblies as separate groups sorted by key = rest order + how far the assembly has moved toward the viewer; re-append the groups only when the order changes. A part that wraps another (a spring round its rod) is split into a back half and a front half.
- **Built once**: all geometry is precomputed into SVG paths at load; per frame only transforms change, plus the needle path and the readout text. A spring compresses by scaling its coil vertically about its seat.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the card paper and the fill of every solid; `--latar-2` is the page around the card.
- `--teks` is the ink. Every grey is mixed from `--teks` into `--latar`: side tones `--nada-0…3` (14, 10, 6.5, 3.3 % ink), lines `--g-hi` (92 %), `--g-mid` (53 %), `--g-lo` (33 %), `--g-faint` (18 %), the halo `--bayang`. So a dark brand gives a dark drawing with light lines, the look's own dark theme.
- `--utama-di-latar` is the one lit part (the needle, 3.2 px) and the number in the caption. `--utama` and `--aksen` are not used as fills: colour only when colour is the subject.
- `--teks-redup` for the title, hint and sub-caption; `--teks` for "Fig 1" and the readout.

## 4. Type

- **Card corners** use a fixed mono (`--font-mono`, IBM Plex Mono): "Fig 1" 25 px; the title in caps tracked .12em; the hint caps tracked .12em 23 px with a pill (600 weight, 1.5 px faint ring, a mid dot); the readout 28 px with tabular figures. On a 1080-wide vertical: 27–30 px.
- **Caption under the card**: `--font-judul` 600, 46 px at 1920 wide (62 px vertical), one plain sentence; `--font-isi` 27 px (35 px vertical) for the second line in `--teks-redup`. Inter by default; any calm grotesk suits, IBM Plex Sans or Space Grotesk too.
- **Legend keys** beside or under the caption: a short line swatch and a 22 px label per tone that matters.
- **Readout grammar**: short and true, read from where the parts are, not from the target: `1,25 kg · ongkir Rp18.000`, `pelat kosong · 0,00 kg`, phase words while moving (`membongkar…`, `merakit kembali…`, `terurai · 8 rakitan`).

## 5. Motion quality

- **Exponential follow** for moves of position and camera: `1 − e^(−t/τ)`, τ 0.28–0.32 s, normalised over 0.9–1.3 s. No bounce, no overshoot.
- **Real springs** where the subject is springy: a loaded platform and plunger with stiffness 420 and damping 26 (a ~8 % overshoot, settled in 0.7 s); the readout and needle show the overshoot honestly.
- **Exploded view**: one spring per assembly, stiffness 64 and damping 14.2 (just under critical), settled in 1.1 s; starts staggered 0.06 s in an order that lets nothing pass through anything (the gauge lifts first so its plunger clears); closing runs the reverse order. Lifts of 25–100 units, outer parts spread 13 units outward as they rise.
- **Text**: the caption, sub and hint fade up 14 px in 0.35 s `power2.out`, staggered 0.06 s, on each beat. Corners never move.
- **Rhythm**: one mechanical event per beat (2.4–4.2 s), then a held reading of 0.6 s or more. The last beat is a still drawing for 2 s or more.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked full card, figure at 55–65 % | the machine as the whole idea | a hook; the closing line; a summary |
| Follow push to the gauge (2.4–2.5×) | read this exact value | a guess versus the truth; a threshold; a limit |
| Follow push to subject and gauge (1.2×) | the result in context | the number; the price; the dose |
| Pull back (0.75–0.85×) for the explode | what is inside, part by part | how it works; what you get; ingredients |
| Held still drawing | time to read the card and caption | a CTA; a payoff |

## 7. Native moves

- **Place and read.** The subject is lowered onto the machine, the mechanism gives under it on a real spring, and the needle swings, overshoots a little and settles while the readout counts. *Fits content like:* a shop weighing a parcel for shipping; a coffee stall dosing beans on a scale; a teacher measuring a bag's weight for a physics class; a story's first clue read off a gauge.
- **Ghost needle.** Push in on the dial; a dotted needle shows the guess beside the real one and the readout names both. *Fits content like:* guessed versus real weight; estimated versus actual cooking time; a creator's expected versus real watch time; a target versus where a class stands.
- **The explode.** Assemblies lift off on staggered springs, outer parts spreading, depth re-sorted as they pass, then fold back from the inside out. *Fits content like:* what is inside a product; the parts of a service; how a scale, a lock or a grinder works; a lesson on a simple machine.
- **True readout.** Every number on screen comes from the model the parts move with: the corner readout updates per frame, the caption states the rounded rule. *Fits content like:* shipping cost from weight; price from portions; points from attendance; a budget from usage.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Boxes, arrows and labels instead of a machine; or one big slab with a few lines: build a real object from 40+ small parts.
- Thick outlines or bright fills: lines stay 1.3 px (at 1920) in greys mixed from the ink; only one part carries colour.
- Lines that stop in the air, ticks off the strip, a spring not touching its seat or platform, a plunger not touching what it reads.
- Wrong overlap: a part drawn over what is in front of it. Keep the static base first, sort moving assemblies by rest order plus their move toward the viewer, split wrapping parts.
- Redrawing geometry every frame (hundreds of paths): build once, move with transforms; only the needle path and the readout text change.
- A readout that disagrees with the needle, or phase words with a number from another instant.
- Animated blur or live 3D for halos, light or water: use radial gradients and flat 2D shapes.
- Busy camera: one push per beat, follow eased, and a still last frame.

# Isometric anatomy: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3.0, long 4.2.

## hook

- en: the whole machine in its Fig card; the subject is placed on it and the needle swings to a live reading
- id: seluruh mesin di kartu Fig; benda utama diletakkan, jarum berayun ke angka yang terbaca langsung

## problem

- en: push in on the gauge; a dotted ghost needle shows the guess beside the real needle, readout names both
- id: kamera mendekat ke jam ukur; jarum titik-titik menunjukkan tebakan di samping jarum asli, angka menyebut keduanya

## fact

- en: pull back and explode the machine: assemblies lift on staggered springs, re-sorted in depth, then fold back
- id: kamera mundur, mesin terurai: rakitan naik dengan pegas berjenjang, urutan kedalaman diatur ulang, lalu dirakit lagi

## step

- en: one part moves at a time (carriage, plunger, knob) and the needle and readout follow from the same model
- id: satu bagian bergerak tiap langkah (kereta, plunyer, kenop), jarum dan angka mengikuti dari model yang sama

## compare

- en: the same machine in two states: ghost part or dotted needle for the before, solid part for the after
- id: mesin yang sama dalam dua keadaan: bagian bayangan atau jarum titik untuk sebelum, bagian padat untuk sesudah

## number

- en: gentle push in on subject and gauge; the readout corner states the true value, the caption repeats it in the main colour
- id: kamera mendekat pelan ke benda dan jam ukur; sudut angka menyebut nilai asli, keterangan mengulangnya dalam warna utama

## proof

- en: the machine repeats its cycle for a second subject and the readout lands on the same rule, nothing else moves
- id: mesin mengulang siklusnya untuk benda kedua dan angkanya mengikuti aturan yang sama, yang lain diam

## offer

- en: the subject sits lit on the machine; caption gives the price or deal, readout shows the measured value it rests on
- id: benda utama tampil di atas mesin; keterangan menyebut harga atau tawaran, angka menunjukkan nilai ukur dasarnya

## cta

- en: full drawing at rest, hint pill names the action, caption gives the line and contact; held 2 s
- id: gambar utuh diam, pil petunjuk menyebut tindakan, keterangan memuat kalimat ajakan dan kontak; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the machine settles to its final reading, readout holds the result, one closing caption; held 2 s
- id: mesin berhenti di angka akhirnya, sudut angka menahan hasilnya, satu keterangan penutup; diam 2 detik

      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Sisanya milik gaya ini:

         jadi brand gelap menghasilkan gambar gelap. Jarum adalah satu-satunya bagian berwarna (--utama). */

        --latar: #fbfbfa; --latar-2: #f2f2ef; --utama: #e5484d; --aksen: #3e63dd;
        --teks: #1f1f22; --teks-redup: #66666b; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff; --utama-di-latar: #c9353a; --aksen-di-latar: #3150c0;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
        --muka: var(--latar);
        --nada-0: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 14%, var(--latar));
        --nada-1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 10%, var(--latar));
        --nada-2: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 6.5%, var(--latar));
        --nada-3: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 3.3%, var(--latar));
        --g-hi: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 92%, var(--latar));
        --g-mid: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 53%, var(--latar));
        --g-lo: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 33%, var(--latar));
        --g-faint: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 18%, var(--latar));
        --bayang: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 55%, var(--latar));
        --garis: 1.3px;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar-2); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar-2); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      /* Kartu: kertas dengan garis tepi mid 1.5 px; empat sudut berisi Fig, judul, petunjuk, angka langsung. */
      .kartu { position: absolute; left: 64px; top: 48px; width: 1792px; height: 848px; background: var(--latar);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--g-mid); overflow: hidden; }
      .cam { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1792px; height: 848px; transform-origin: 0 0; }
      .cam svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; overflow: visible; }
      .sudut { position: absolute; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 25px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: .04em; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .fig { left: 100px; top: 86px; color: var(--teks); }
      .judul-fig { right: 100px; top: 86px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .12em; }
      .angka { right: 100px; top: 836px; color: var(--teks); font-size: 28px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
      .petunjuk { position: absolute; left: 100px; top: 822px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 23px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); white-space: nowrap; }
      /* Sudut bawah tetap terbaca saat kamera mendekat: tambalan kertas tipis di belakang teksnya. */
      .angka, .petunjuk > span:last-child { background: var(--latar); box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px var(--latar); }
      .pil { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--g-faint);
        background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; }
      .pil i { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--g-mid); }
      /* Keterangan di bawah kartu, seperti legenda gambar teknik. */
      .cap { position: absolute; left: 64px; top: 926px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 600; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.1;
        letter-spacing: -.01em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .cap b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .sub { position: absolute; left: 66px; top: 992px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-size: 27px; color: var(--teks-redup); white-space: nowrap; }
      .kunci { position: absolute; right: 64px; top: 1000px; display: flex; gap: 34px; font-family: var(--font-isi); font-size: 22px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .kunci span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
      .kunci svg path { fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      /* Gambar: sisi berisi kertas, empat nada menurut arah hadap, garis tipis berujung bulat. */
      .fi { fill: var(--muka); } .tp { fill: var(--muka); }
      .s0 { fill: var(--nada-0); } .s1 { fill: var(--nada-1); } .s2 { fill: var(--nada-2); } .s3 { fill: var(--nada-3); }
      .ln { fill: none; stroke-width: var(--garis); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      .hi { stroke: var(--g-hi); } .mid { stroke: var(--g-mid); } .lo { stroke: var(--g-lo); } .fa { stroke: var(--g-faint); }
      .lit { stroke: var(--utama-di-latar); stroke-width: 3.2px; } .titik { fill: var(--g-hi); opacity: .55; }
      .putus { stroke: var(--g-mid); stroke-width: 2.4px; stroke-dasharray: .01 7; }
      .huruf { fill: var(--g-mid); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 4px; letter-spacing: .04em; }
      .b0 { stop-color: var(--bayang); stop-opacity: .34; } .b1 { stop-color: var(--bayang); stop-opacity: 0; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <div class="kartu">
        <div class="cam" id="cam"><svg id="gbr" width="1792" height="848" viewBox="0 0 1792 848"></svg></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sudut fig">Fig 1</div>
      <div class="sudut judul-fig">Timbangan paket</div>
      <div class="sudut angka" id="angka">pelat kosong · 0,00 kg</div>
      <div class="kunci">
        <span><svg width="26" height="12"><path d="M2 6 H24" style="stroke: var(--utama-di-latar)" /></svg>jarum, berat terbaca</span>
        <span><svg width="26" height="12"><path d="M2 6 H24" style="stroke: var(--g-mid)" /></svg>pelat, pegas, rangka</span>
      </div>
      <!-- Satu mesin sepanjang video; adegan hanya mengganti keterangan, petunjuk, kamera dan keadaan mesinnya. -->
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Timbang</span><span>Taruh paket di pelat</span></div>
        <div class="cap">Paket ini ongkirnya berapa?</div>
        <div class="sub">Di Toko Kirim Rapi, setiap paket ditimbang dulu.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="problem">
        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Baca</span><span>Bandingkan dengan tebakan</span></div>
        <div class="cap">Ditebak 1 kg, ternyata 1,25 kg.</div>
        <div class="sub">Selisih seperempat kilo itu bisa menggeser ongkirnya.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="fact">
        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Bongkar</span><span>Lihat bagian dalamnya</span></div>
        <div class="cap">Isinya sederhana: pelat, empat pegas, satu jarum.</div>
        <div class="sub">Makin berat paketnya, pegas makin turun dan jarum makin jauh berputar.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="number">
        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Hitung</span><span>Berat dibulatkan ke atas</span></div>
        <div class="cap">1,25 kg jadi ongkir <b>Rp18.000</b></div>
        <div class="sub">Dihitung 2 kg × Rp9.000, bukan tebakan 1 kg.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="scene" id="s5" data-role="cta">
        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Kirim</span><span>Siap diantar kurir</span></div>
        <div class="cap">Timbang dulu, baru kirim.</div>
        <div class="sub">Toko Kirim Rapi · Chat 0812-3456-7890</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      // Tata letak per orientasi: kotak gambar di dalam kartu dan titik tuju kamera (koordinat kartu).
      const LAYOUT = { box: [190, 112, 1412, 680], dial: { at: [896, 380], s: 2.5 }, apart: { at: [896, 520], s: 0.74 }, isi: { at: [900, 360], s: 1.18 } };

      // ---- Kit isometrik kecil (port dari kit sumber): dunia x, y di lantai, z ke atas; azimut 42°, elevasi 30°.
      const RAD = Math.PI / 180, sA = Math.sin(42 * RAD), cA = Math.cos(42 * RAD), sE = Math.sin(30 * RAD), cE = Math.cos(30 * RAD);
      let O = [0, 0], K = 1;
      const iso = ([x, y, z]) => [O[0] + (x * sA - y * cA) * K, O[1] + ((x * cA + y * sA) * sE - z * cE) * K];
      const dep = ([x, y, z]) => (x * cA + y * sA) * cE + z * sE;
      const pth = (ps, c) => ps.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + p[0].toFixed(1) + " " + p[1].toFixed(1)).join("") + (c ? "Z" : "");
      const ring = (cx, cy, r, n = 36) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [cx + r * Math.cos((i / n) * 2 * Math.PI), cy + r * Math.sin((i / n) * 2 * Math.PI)]);
      function plan({ x, y, w, d, r }, st = 6) {
        const out = [];
        [[x + w - r, y + r, -90], [x + w - r, y + d - r, 0], [x + r, y + d - r, 90], [x + r, y + r, 180]].forEach(([cx, cy, a0]) => {
          for (let s = 0; s <= st; s++) { const a = (a0 + (90 * s) / st) * RAD; out.push([cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)]); }
        });
        return out;
      }
      function hull(ps) {
        const s = [...ps].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]), cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]);
        const half = (list) => { const h = []; for (const p of list) { while (h.length > 1 && cr(h[h.length - 2], h[h.length - 1], p) <= 0) h.pop(); h.push(p); } return h.slice(0, -1); };
        return [...half(s), ...half(s.reverse())];
      }
      function runs(f, want) {
        const n = f.length, out = [], st = f.findIndex((v, i) => v !== f[(i + n - 1) % n]);
        if (st < 0) return f[0] === want ? [Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, i) => i % n)] : [];
        let run = null;
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const i = (st + k) % n; if (f[i] === want) { (run = run || [i]).push((i + 1) % n); } else if (run) { out.push(run); run = null; } }
        if (run) out.push(run);
        return out;
      }
      // Ekstrusi: isi, empat nada sisi menurut arah cahaya, atas, garis lipat dan garis luar.
      function extrude(rg, z, h) {
        const n = rg.length; let area = 0;
        rg.forEach(([ax, ay], i) => { const [bx, by] = rg[(i + 1) % n]; area += ax * by - bx * ay; });
        const nm = rg.map(([ax, ay], i) => { const [bx, by] = rg[(i + 1) % n], l = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay) || 1; return area > 0 ? [(by - ay) / l, -(bx - ax) / l] : [-(by - ay) / l, (bx - ax) / l]; });
        const face = nm.map(([nx, ny]) => nx * cA + ny * sA > 1e-9), top = rg.map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, z + h])), bot = rg.map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, z]));
        const out = [], crease = [], sh = [[], [], [], []];
        runs(face, false).forEach((r) => out.push(pth(r.map((i) => top[i]))));
        runs(face, true).forEach((r) => { crease.push(pth(r.map((i) => top[i]))); if (h > 0) out.push(pth(r.map((i) => bot[i]))); });
        for (let i = 0; i < n && h > 0; i++) {
          if (face[(i + n - 1) % n] !== face[i]) out.push(pth([top[i], bot[i]]));
          if (!face[i]) continue;
          const j = (i + 1) % n, lit = (nm[i][0] * -sA + nm[i][1] * cA + 1) / 2;

  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">

        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Baca</span><span>Bandingkan dengan tebakan</span></div>

        <div class="petunjuk"><span class="pil"><i></i>Kirim</span><span>Siap diantar kurir</span></div>

    </div>
    <script>
      // Tata letak per orientasi: kotak gambar di dalam kartu dan titik tuju kamera (koordinat kartu).
      const LAYOUT = { box: [50, 380, 900, 640], dial: { at: [500, 500], s: 2.4 }, apart: { at: [500, 820], s: 0.86 }, isi: { at: [520, 640], s: 1.2 } };

      // ---- Kit isometrik kecil (port dari kit sumber): dunia x, y di lantai, z ke atas; azimut 42°, elevasi 30°.
      const RAD = Math.PI / 180, sA = Math.sin(42 * RAD), cA = Math.cos(42 * RAD), sE = Math.sin(30 * RAD), cE = Math.cos(30 * RAD);
      let O = [0, 0], K = 1;
      const iso = ([x, y, z]) => [O[0] + (x * sA - y * cA) * K, O[1] + ((x * cA + y * sA) * sE - z * cE) * K];
      const dep = ([x, y, z]) => (x * cA + y * sA) * cE + z * sE;
      const pth = (ps, c) => ps.map((p, i) => (i ? "L" : "M") + p[0].toFixed(1) + " " + p[1].toFixed(1)).join("") + (c ? "Z" : "");
      const ring = (cx, cy, r, n = 36) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => [cx + r * Math.cos((i / n) * 2 * Math.PI), cy + r * Math.sin((i / n) * 2 * Math.PI)]);
      function plan({ x, y, w, d, r }, st = 6) {
        const out = [];
        [[x + w - r, y + r, -90], [x + w - r, y + d - r, 0], [x + r, y + d - r, 90], [x + r, y + r, 180]].forEach(([cx, cy, a0]) => {
          for (let s = 0; s <= st; s++) { const a = (a0 + (90 * s) / st) * RAD; out.push([cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)]); }
        });
        return out;
      }
      function hull(ps) {
        const s = [...ps].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]), cr = (o, a, b) => (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0]);
        const half = (list) => { const h = []; for (const p of list) { while (h.length > 1 && cr(h[h.length - 2], h[h.length - 1], p) <= 0) h.pop(); h.push(p); } return h.slice(0, -1); };
        return [...half(s), ...half(s.reverse())];
      }
      function runs(f, want) {
        const n = f.length, out = [], st = f.findIndex((v, i) => v !== f[(i + n - 1) % n]);
        if (st < 0) return f[0] === want ? [Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, i) => i % n)] : [];
        let run = null;
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { const i = (st + k) % n; if (f[i] === want) { (run = run || [i]).push((i + 1) % n); } else if (run) { out.push(run); run = null; } }
        if (run) out.push(run);
        return out;
      }
      // Ekstrusi: isi, empat nada sisi menurut arah cahaya, atas, garis lipat dan garis luar.
      function extrude(rg, z, h) {
        const n = rg.length; let area = 0;
        rg.forEach(([ax, ay], i) => { const [bx, by] = rg[(i + 1) % n]; area += ax * by - bx * ay; });
        const nm = rg.map(([ax, ay], i) => { const [bx, by] = rg[(i + 1) % n], l = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay) || 1; return area > 0 ? [(by - ay) / l, -(bx - ax) / l] : [-(by - ay) / l, (bx - ax) / l]; });
        const face = nm.map(([nx, ny]) => nx * cA + ny * sA > 1e-9), top = rg.map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, z + h])), bot = rg.map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, z]));
        const out = [], crease = [], sh = [[], [], [], []];
        runs(face, false).forEach((r) => out.push(pth(r.map((i) => top[i]))));
        runs(face, true).forEach((r) => { crease.push(pth(r.map((i) => top[i]))); if (h > 0) out.push(pth(r.map((i) => bot[i]))); });
        for (let i = 0; i < n && h > 0; i++) {
          if (face[(i + n - 1) % n] !== face[i]) out.push(pth([top[i], bot[i]]));
          if (!face[i]) continue;
          const j = (i + 1) % n, lit = (nm[i][0] * -sA + nm[i][1] * cA + 1) / 2;
          sh[Math.min(3, Math.floor(lit * 4))].push(pth([top[i], top[j], bot[j], bot[i]], true));
        }
        return { fill: pth(hull([...top, ...bot]), true), top: pth(top, true), sh, out: out.join(""), crease: crease.join("") };
      }
      const slab = (p, z, h, st) => extrude(plan(p, st), z, h);
      const cyl = (cx, cy, r, z, h, n = 32) => extrude(ring(cx, cy, r, n), z, h);
      const S = (p, tone = "mid", crease = "fa") =>
        `<g><path class="fi" d="${p.fill}"/>${p.sh.map((d, i) => (d.length ? `<path class="s${i}" d="${d.join("")}"/>` : "")).join("")}<path class="tp" d="${p.top}"/>` +
        (crease ? `<path class="ln ${crease}" d="${p.crease}"/>` : "") + `<path class="ln ${tone}" d="${p.out}"/></g>`;
      const L = (d, tone = "lo") => `<path class="ln ${tone}" d="${d}"/>`;
      const D = (pts, r = 1.7) => pts.map((p) => { const [x, y] = iso(p); return `<circle class="titik" cx="${x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${y.toFixed(1)}" r="${r}"/>`; }).join("");
      const onTop = (pts, z, c) => pth(pts.map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, z])), c);
      const seg = (a, b) => pth([iso(a), iso(b)]);
      const inset = ({ x, y, w, d, r }, b) => ({ x: x + b, y: y + b, w: w - 2 * b, d: d - 2 * b, r: Math.max(0, r - b) });
      const corners = ({ x, y, w, d }, i) => [[x + i, y + i], [x + w - i, y + i], [x + w - i, y + d - i], [x + i, y + d - i]];
      const kartel = (cx, cy, r, z0, z1, n) => ring(cx, cy, r, n).filter(([x, y]) => ((x - cx) * cA + (y - cy) * sA) / r > 0.15).map(([x, y]) => seg([x, y, z0 + 0.4], [x, y, z1 - 0.4])).join("");
      const arcSide = (cx, cy, r, z) => pth(Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => { const a = 42 * RAD - Math.PI / 2 + (i / 24) * Math.PI; return iso([cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a), z]); }));
      function ticks(x0, x1, y, z, step, every, lens) {
        const t = [[], []];
        for (let x = x0, i = 0; x <= x1 + 1e-6; x += step, i++) t[i % every ? 0 : 1].push(onTop([[x, y], [x, y + lens[i % every ? 0 : 1]]], z));
        return L(t[0].join(""), "lo") + L(t[1].join(""), "mid");
      }
      function coil(cx, cy, r, z0, z1, turns) {
        const back = [], front = []; let run = [], near = null;
        for (let i = 0, n = turns * 18; i <= n; i++) {
          const a = (i / n) * turns * 2 * Math.PI, p = iso([cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a), z0 + ((z1 - z0) * i) / n]), f = Math.cos(a) * cA + Math.sin(a) * sA > 0;
          if (near === null) near = f;
          run.push(p);
          if (f !== near) { (near ? front : back).push(pth(run)); run = [p]; near = f; }
        }
        (near ? front : back).push(pth(run));
        return [back.join(""), front.join("")];
      }

      // ---- Model: satu sumber untuk gerak, jarum dan angka. 6 satuan turun per kg, satu putaran jarum = 2 kg.
      const PLATE = { x: -150, y: -80, w: 292, d: 160, r: 8 }, PLAT = { x: -132, y: -52, w: 122, d: 104, r: 4 };
      const SPRINGS = corners(PLAT, 15), PB = 30, PT = 36, PER_KG = 6, PER_TURN = 12, FREE = 9, BERAT = 1.25;
      const PKG = { x: -114, y: -32, w: 70, d: 62, r: 1.5 }, PKG_H = 40, DIAL = [2, 0], DR = 22, DZ = 92, DT = 102, POST = [74, 0], CZ = 100;
      const MOVE = { gauge: [0, 0, 64], pkg: [0, 0, 100], plat: [0, 0, 52], knob: [0, 0, 22] };
      SPRINGS.forEach(([x, y], i) => (MOVE["sp" + i] = [Math.sign(x - (PLAT.x + PLAT.w / 2)) * 13, Math.sign(y) * 13, 30]));
      const ORDER = ["gauge", "pkg", "plat", "sp0", "sp1", "sp2", "sp3", "knob"];
      const st = { drop: 190, load: 0, ghost: 0, mode: 0 };
      ORDER.forEach((k) => (st[k] = 0));

      // Kamera pas ke kotak gambar (termasuk paket yang terangkat saat dibongkar).
      (function fit() {
        const pts = [...corners(PLATE, 0).flatMap(([x, y]) => [[x, y, -17], [x, y, 0]]), [POST[0], 0, 192], [PKG.x, PKG.y, PT + PKG_H], [DIAL[0] - DR, 0, DT]];
        K = 1; O = [0, 0];
        const fl = pts.map(iso), xs = fl.map((p) => p[0]), ys = fl.map((p) => p[1]), [bx, by, bw, bh] = LAYOUT.box;
        K = Math.min(bw / (Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs)), bh / (Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys)));
        O = [bx + bw / 2 - ((Math.max(...xs) + Math.min(...xs)) / 2) * K, by + bh / 2 - ((Math.max(...ys) + Math.min(...ys)) / 2) * K];
      })();

      // ---- Bagian diam, digambar sekali: alas berkaki, alur, sekrup, mistar, pelat label, dudukan pegas.
      const base = [];
      const halo = [...corners(inset(PLATE, -14), 0)].map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, -17]));
      base.push(`<path d="${pth(hull(halo), true)}" fill="url(#bg)"/>`);
      corners(PLATE, 22).sort((a, b) => dep([...a, 0]) - dep([...b, 0])).forEach(([x, y]) => base.push(S(cyl(x, y, 7, -17, 1.6), "lo"), S(cyl(x, y, 5.4, -15.4, 3.4), "mid")));
      base.push(S(slab(PLATE, -12, 12, 8), "mid"), L(onTop(plan(inset(PLATE, 5), 8), 0, true), "lo"));
      corners(PLATE, 10).forEach(([x, y]) => base.push(L(pth(ring(x, y, 2.4, 16).map(([a, b]) => iso([a, b, 0])), true), "lo"), D([[x, y, 0]], 1.4)));
      const RULER = { x: -128, y: PLATE.y + PLATE.d - 15, w: 250, d: 7, r: 1 };
      base.push(S(slab(RULER, 0, 0.6, 3), "lo", null), ticks(RULER.x + 4, RULER.x + RULER.w - 4, RULER.y + 0.8, 0.6, 4, 5, [2, 3.8]), D([[RULER.x + 2, RULER.y + 3.5, 0.6], [RULER.x + RULER.w - 2, RULER.y + 3.5, 0.6]], 1.3));
      const LABEL = { x: 96, y: 26, w: 34, d: 22, r: 1.2 };
      base.push(S(slab(LABEL, 0, 0.8, 3), "lo", null), [7, 11, 15].map((y) => L(onTop([[LABEL.x + 5, LABEL.y + y], [LABEL.x + LABEL.w - (y === 15 ? 14 : 5), LABEL.y + y]], 0.8), "fa")).join(""));
      base.push(D([[LABEL.x + 2.4, LABEL.y + 2.4, 0.8], [LABEL.x + LABEL.w - 2.4, LABEL.y + LABEL.d - 2.4, 0.8]], 1.2));
      [...SPRINGS].sort((a, b) => dep([...a, 0]) - dep([...b, 0])).forEach(([x, y]) => base.push(S(cyl(x, y, 7.4, 0, 2), "mid")));

      // ---- Rakitan yang bergerak; masing-masing satu <g> dengan kunci urut sendiri.
      const items = {}, svg = document.getElementById("gbr"), NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      SPRINGS.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
        const [back, front] = coil(x, y, 5.6, 2, PB, 5);
        items["sp" + i] = { key: i * 0.5 + dep([x, y, 0]) * 0.01, html: `<g data-s>${L(back, "lo")}</g>${S(cyl(x, y, 1.7, 2, 18, 12), "mid", null)}<g data-s>${L(front, "mid")}</g>`, base: iso([x, y, 2])[1] };
      });
      const TAB = { x: -14, y: -7, w: 25, d: 14, r: 1.5 };
      items.plat = { key: 3, html: S(slab(PLAT, PB, PT - PB, 5), "mid") + S(slab(TAB, PB + 1, PT - PB - 1, 3), "mid") + D([[TAB.x + TAB.w - 3, TAB.y + 3, PT], [TAB.x + TAB.w - 3, TAB.y + TAB.d - 3, PT]], 1.2) + L(onTop(plan(inset(PLAT, 4), 5), PT, true), "fa") +
        D(SPRINGS.map(([x, y]) => [x, y, PT]), 1.5) + L(onTop([[PLAT.x + 8, PLAT.y + PLAT.d - 3], [PLAT.x + PLAT.w - 8, PLAT.y + PLAT.d - 3]], PT), "fa") +
        `<path data-shadow d="${pth(hull(corners(inset(PKG, -10), 0).map(([x, y]) => iso([x, y, PT + 0.1]))), true)}" fill="url(#bg)"/>` };
      const pkgTop = PT + PKG_H, cx = PKG.x + PKG.w / 2;
      items.pkg = { key: 4, html: S(slab(PKG, PT, PKG_H, 3), "hi", "lo") +
        L(onTop([[PKG.x, -6], [PKG.x + PKG.w, -6]], pkgTop) + onTop([[PKG.x, 6], [PKG.x + PKG.w, 6]], pkgTop), "lo") +
        L(seg([PKG.x + PKG.w, -6, pkgTop], [PKG.x + PKG.w, -6, PT + 0.5]) + seg([PKG.x + PKG.w, 6, pkgTop], [PKG.x + PKG.w, 6, PT + 0.5]), "lo") +
        L(onTop(plan({ x: PKG.x + 6, y: 12, w: 26, d: 16, r: 1 }, 2), pkgTop, true), "mid") +
        [5, 9, 13].map((y) => L(onTop([[PKG.x + 10, 12 + y - 2], [PKG.x + (y === 13 ? 20 : 28), 12 + y - 2]], pkgTop), "fa")).join("") };
